_comment: ASP.NET WebForms + jQuery/jqGrid (Reference) -> Blazor + MudBlazor (Target). Extends generic. Only add entries the team agrees are not visible defects, always with a reason; per-page css-map.json 'accepted' entries override these.
name: webforms-jqgrid__blazor-mudblazor
description: WebForms with jqGrid/jQuery UI to Blazor with MudBlazor.

accepted.reason: MudBlazor shows the not-allowed cursor on disabled controls; WebForms keeps the browser default
Material header weight 500 vs jqGrid semibold 600, agreed acceptable (no visual break); bold 700 headers stay counted
jQuery UI text #454545 vs MudBlazor text #424242: 3 units per channel, not distinguishable; other colors stay counted
MudCheckBox keeps the native input at opacity 0 under its visible SVG box; the checkbox itself is visible
MudBlazor floating labels are drawn on the input's top border by design; the label position difference stays counted as layout.labelPosition
MudBlazor renders the input before its floating label in the DOM; on screen the label is still first (layout.labelPosition stays counted)
